description: This Java source file defines the SSLServerSocketFactory class, which implements the RMIServerSocketFactory interface to create SSL server sockets with configurable key store and client authentication settings. The class is used within the Apache OFBiz framework for secure RMI communication over SSL.

classes.name: SSLServerSocketFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating SSL-enabled server sockets for Java RMI, supporting configuration of keystore, alias, and client authentication.

methods.name: setNeedClientAuth
methods.description: Configures whether the created SSL server socket requires client authentication.

methods.name: setKeyStore
methods.description: Sets the keystore location, type, and password used to load the SSL certificate.

methods.name: setKeyStoreAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias of the SSL certificate within the keystore to be used.

methods.name: createServerSocket
methods.description: Creates and returns an SSL server socket bound to the specified port with the configured SSL settings.
